items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: when I started working with Buddy Petit... I stayed with him quite a while.

ctx.x: I was going to say, tell us about, not Chris Kelly, but Buddy Petit, when you started working with him.

Well, when I started working with Buddy Petit, we used to play at the fairground here in New Orleans. That time, we used to have two bands there. I stayed with him quite a while. In fact, I was with him when he first took his stroke. First stroke he took. And we used to advertise in the streets and have fun all the time. At that time, we used to have plenty of bands in the street. We don't have that here in New Orleans no more. And, uh...
They have wagons or trucks in those days?
